long_biography.plain_text:
Before property, Nick Leslau managed a 36-person grocery staff in Belsize Park while still a teenager. He financed his estate-management studies through market stalls and casting work for music videos. After qualifying as a chartered surveyor, he joined a small property business and became chief executive in his mid-twenties as it entered public markets.

Leslau developed a preference for off-market transactions and for matching properties with long, inflation-protected leases. After successive listed-property mergers, he remained invested in the enlarged group and joined LondonMetric’s board. He now works with Sandy Gumm and Ben Walford in a three-person Prestbury Capital Partners team.
